result.title: Training-Free 3D Editing via Feature-Divergence Localization and Trajectory Correction
result.summary: Modifying 3D assets requires enacting targeted structural transformations while strictly preserving the geometric identity of unedited regions. While recent probability flow models enable training-free editing, bounding these modifications within a high-dimensional latent space presents severe mathematical challenges. Current inversion-free trajectories rely on global velocity updates, which often cause spatial bleed into preserved structures and induce trajectory under-commitment, causing edits to stall mid-path. To resolve these dual failures, we introduce FocusFlow, a segmentation-free framework that structures the integration trajectory into two disjoint phases. During early coarse structure formation, FocusFlow applies Feature-Divergence Localization (FDL) to spatially gate the velocity field using intrinsic cross-attention. Once coarse structure has formed, FocusFlow applies Reference Generation Guidance (RGG), a trajectory-correction term that drives convergence to the target shape by pulling the trajectory toward an explicit clean-latent target. Evaluated on the joint Google Scanned Objects and PartObjaverse-Tiny benchmarks, FocusFlow obtains the best preservation scores and the largest edit magnitude among compared methods, suggesting that it can reduce the traditional preservation-modification trade-off. By providing stable, localized geometric control without manual spatial annotations, this phase-scheduled approach lowers technical barriers to the modification of synthetic 3D media.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出免训练 3D 编辑框架 FocusFlow，把积分轨迹拆成两个阶段：粗结构形成期用特征散度定位（FDL）借内部交叉注意力对速度场做空间门控，结构成形后用参考生成引导（RGG）把轨迹拉向显式的干净 latent 目标以完成编辑收敛。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按阶段调度 latent 更新＋显式干净 latent 目标校正轨迹＋注意力定位后局部化更新」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新、停止与收敛判定及视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索，但原文属 3D 编辑领域，迁移性待验证。
